LanguageData.WR_OptNumericTipOff: Priority grids (including mods like Numbers) draw checkmarks
LanguageData.WR_OptNumericTipWhy: It lives here because WorkRoles replaces the vanilla Work tab that hosted it.
LanguageData.WR_OptVanillaRange: Report vanilla 0-4 priorities to other mods
LanguageData.WR_OptVanillaRangeTipWhat: WorkRoles orders work by unique priorities (sequential numbers starting with 1).
LanguageData.WR_OptVanillaRangeTipOff: Other mods see those priorities as-is
LanguageData.WR_OptVanillaRangeTipOn: Priorities are mapped onto vanilla's 0-4 range
LanguageData.WR_OptAutoOptimizeTipWhat: Runs Fix My Colony automatically for each colony and applies the changes, per savegame.
LanguageData.WR_OptAutoOptimizeTipOff: Role assignments only change when you edit them
LanguageData.WR_OptAutoOptimizeTipOn: Recommended assignments are applied at the top of every in-game hour
LanguageData.WR_OptAutoOptimizeTipWhy: Pinned assignments are never touched, and nothing is written when a colonist already matches the recommendation.
LanguageData.WR_AutoOptimizeConfirmApply: Apply makes the changes below now and turns hourly auto-optimization on. While it is on, the Fix My Colony and Make It So buttons are hidden; you can still assign, re-order and pin roles as usual.
LanguageData.WR_AutoOptimizeGlobalWarning: You have multiple colonies: auto-optimization is GLOBAL and will change role assignments in ALL of them every hour. The preview below only shows changes for the current colony.
LanguageData.WR_OptSkillCaptions: Show top skills under colonist names
LanguageData.WR_OptSkillCaptionsTip: Each colonist row in the table carries a small caption under the name listing that colonist's best work skills with their levels, coloured by suitability. Turn this off to render the name on its own line.
LanguageData.WR_OptVerdictsColonists: Show verdicts on colonist role chips
LanguageData.WR_OptVerdictsColonistsTip: Each role chip in the colonist table shows a suitability star pair for the colonist holding it, matching the recommendation engine's judgment: white stars for good verdicts (one strong, two great, gold exceptional), red stars for bad ones (one poor, two awful), grey for neutral.
LanguageData.WR_OptVerdictsPalette: Show verdicts for the selected colonist in the role palette
LanguageData.WR_OptVerdictsPaletteTip: Palette chips show how well suited each role is for the currently selected colonist.
LanguageData.WR_OptVerdictsRecommendations: Show verdicts on recommended role chips
LanguageData.WR_OptVerdictsRecommendationsTip: Recommended role chips (stats panel and change previews) show the suitability verdict for the colonist they are recommended to.
LanguageData.WR_RecGlobalPanelHelp: These options modify how the recommendation engine scores/ranks candidates as well as where orders land in the final recommendation list. Use the Reset buttons to restore defaults if you regret your edits.
LanguageData.WR_RecRolePanelHelp: Lists the roles from the default recommendation order above. If a role is missing here, first add it to the recommendation order.
LanguageData.WR_RecOrderHelp: This list defines the set of roles that the recommendation engine will consider. Training roles are included through training path membership (configured per role below). The order of roles in this list is used as a tie-breaker when determining the final recommendation order for a colonist.
LanguageData.WR_OptRecOrderTipWhat: The order recommendations list roles in, derived from the vanilla priority grid (auto-assigned roles included).
LanguageData.WR_ActRecX: Unpin the role so it places dynamically again
LanguageData.WR_RecOrderChipTip: Drag to reorder (this is only a hint, not a fixed recommendation order). Unlisted roles may still be recommended.
LanguageData.WR_RecOrderAddTip: Add a role to provide a placement hint or to enable the role options below.
LanguageData.WR_OptRecOrderTipAuto: Unlisted roles slot in automatically: training roles after their target, sub-roles after the role covering them, Hunter after the warden/childcare roles.
LanguageData.WR_OptLockedTip: Hunter is now using a fixed recommendation slot. Remove this chip to revert to dynamic positioning based on shooting skill.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneResetTip: Restores this section's options to their default values.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneCellHint: Click a value to raise it, right-click to lower it.
LanguageData.WR_StepModifiersTip:
Click: 1 step.
Shift: 5 steps.
Ctrl: 10 steps.
Ctrl+Shift: jump to the limit.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneChampionSectionIntro: Each role first gets a champion: the colonist best suited to anchor it. These options decide who qualifies and how skill and signal strength are weighed against each other.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOrderingSectionIntro: Once a colonist's roles are chosen, these options decide the order they are listed in, which is also their work priority order.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalSection: Training path and optional target options
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalSectionIntro: These options decide when a training path activates for a colonist and when an optional multi-skill role is worth recommending at all.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneLeadSectionIntro: When several training paths share a target, these options spread the lead roles across different colonists instead of stacking them on one.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneHunterSectionIntro: An unpinned Hunter role slots in dynamically based on shooting skill: better shooters hunt later in the priority order because their time is worth more elsewhere.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneCandidateMinimumSignalDesc: Lowest signal admitted to ordinary role selection. Raising it removes weaker candidates before champion and minimum-holder selection.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneChampionSkillDivisorDesc: Champion skill contribution is ceil(skill level ÷ this value). Raising it reduces the influence of raw skill.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneChampionMultiSkillMinimumCount: Minimum number of qualifying target skills needed to sum champion scores. Below this count, only the role's best skill is scored.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneChampionMultiplierRowDesc: Multiplies the rounded skill contribution of each signal strength during champion selection.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneMultiplierAwfulTip: Awful. This column matters only when the candidate minimum signal admits Awful candidates.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneChampionTieBreakRowDesc: Signal points compared when champion scores tie. For multi-skill roles, points are summed across qualifying signals.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneRankedCandidatePrioritySignalD: Non-champion candidates at or above this signal are ranked ahead of weaker candidates before minimum slots are filled.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneSurplusMinimumSignalDesc: After required slots are filled, standard candidates at or above this signal may still receive the role. Level-based promotion applies to single-skill roles within their configured training band; multi-skill targets use the optional-target aptitude requirements.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOrderingSkillDivisorDesc: Final-order skill points are ceil(skill level ÷ this value). Raising it reduces the effect of skill on role order.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOrderingPointsRowDesc: Points each signal strength contributes when final recommended roles are ordered.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneMinimumPickRowDesc: Ordering points granted to the first, second, third and every later pawn selected to satisfy a role's required holder minimum.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneCategoryPointsRowDesc: Ordering points added by colony importance: Important promotes duty roles above same-signal production work, Optional pushes roles toward the end of the list.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneTimePointsRowDesc: Ordering points added by time demand: part-time lets quick duties sit above full-time work of equal signal, opportunistic pushes filler work toward the end.
LanguageData.WR_RecTunePathMinimumSignalDesc: Lowest signal a role may have while participating in an activated training path.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetMinimumSkillCoun: Number of qualifying target skills required before the optional-target aptitude test applies. Roles with fewer qualifying skills bypass this test.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetMinimumSignalDes: A skill must meet this signal before level promotion can affect single-skill surplus eligibility or contribute aptitude points toward an optional target.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetStrongLevelDesc: At this skill level, a weaker qualifying signal is promoted to the configured middle signal for single-skill surplus eligibility and optional-target scoring.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetStrongPromotedSi: Signal used for single-skill surplus eligibility and optional-target aptitude scoring at or above the middle skill promotion level.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetGreatLevelDesc: At this skill level, a weaker qualifying signal is promoted to the configured high signal for single-skill surplus eligibility and optional-target scoring.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetGreatPromotedSig: Signal used for single-skill surplus eligibility and optional-target aptitude scoring at or above the high skill promotion level.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneOptionalTargetMinimumPointsDes: Minimum summed signal steps above the configured signal floor needed to recommend an optional multi-skill target.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneLeadMinimumConnectedTargetsDes: Minimum number of connected training targets before the planner tries to assign their lead roles to different pawns.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneLeadMinimumSignalDesc: Lowest role signal allowed for a pawn chosen as a diversified training-path lead.
LanguageData.WR_RecTuneHunterTiersRowDesc: Shooting-level cutoffs for the dynamic Hunter slot. Tier 1 places Hunter right after basic work, tiers 2 and 3 after the middle and last work roles, and levels above tier 4 place Hunter last.
LanguageData.WR_TrainingHelp: Here you can define how colonists acquire new skills and progress toward this role. A training path can have multiple bands, so that roles can overlap. Colonists will be recommended all roles at their current skill level if the training path is recommended for them.
LanguageData.WR_TrainingTipWhat: The role's own progression: each member role carries a skill band where it is recommended. The role itself always stays in its path.
LanguageData.WR_TrainingTipBands: Overlapping bands coexist; where bands do not overlap the later role replaces the earlier.
LanguageData.WR_TrainingTipOrder: Assignments prioritize higher band minimums. Equal bands prioritize the pawn's weakest role skill, then the stored path order.
LanguageData.WR_WhenPanelCaption: Role progression: Here you can define at what skill the displayed roles are recommended. Overlapping roles complement.
LanguageData.WR_NoContributionRoleTip: Trains none of the skills this role needs, so the path cannot use it as a training step. Mods can change what grants XP, so you may add it anyway.
LanguageData.WR_RoleColonyMinTip: The minimum assignment count for this role.
LanguageData.WR_RoleCoverageTip: What percentage of colonists should ideally get this role.
LanguageData.WR_RoleCategoryTip: How important holding this role is when planning the colony. "Not set" leaves the role unclassified.
LanguageData.WR_RoleTimeTip: How much of a colonist's day this role's work tends to consume.
LanguageData.WR_ChampionPenaltyTip: When enabled, a colonist who already champions other roles is penalized when competing to champion this one. Disable it for roles where repeat championships are fine, such as occasional work.
LanguageData.WR_RoleAgeBandsLabel: Age groups that may be assigned this role:
LanguageData.WR_RoleAgeBandsTip: Colonists outside the selected age bands are never assigned or recommended this role. Click a band outside the selection to include everything up to it, click the first or last selected band to remove it, and click a middle band to select only that band. Band edges follow the ages at which the game unlocks work. Every job in this role is possible from age {0}.
LanguageData.WR_WorkTypesTip: Only colonists able to perform work of the specified types are eligible for this role.\n\nDerived from the selected jobs and shown for information.
LanguageData.WR_UsedSkillsTip: Shows skills that affect jobs in this role. Hover a skill to see its effect.\n\nDerived from the selected jobs and shown for information.
LanguageData.WR_TrainedSkillsTip: Shows skills that gain XP from jobs in this role.\n\nDerived from the selected jobs and shown for information.
LanguageData.WR_GatedSkillsTip: Shows skills that colonists need to perform certain jobs in this role. The minimum skill level depends on which recipe, plant or building is involved. Hover skills to see details.\n\nDerived from the selected jobs and shown for information.
LanguageData.WR_RequiredSkillsTip: Optional hard gates chosen for this role. A colonist with any required skill disabled cannot be recommended the role. Skill level does not affect this gate, and it is separate from content minimums shown under Gated.
LanguageData.WR_AddSkillTip: Add an explicit hard skill gate. This does not change the role's derived Used or Trained skills.
LanguageData.WR_RemoveSkillTip: Remove this explicit hard skill gate.
LanguageData.WR_PathAddRoleTip: Adds a role to this path.
LanguageData.WR_BandChipTip: Drag an end to resize the skill band, drag the middle to move it.
LanguageData.WR_ShowPriorityGridTip: Show the priority grid for all listed colonists, respecting the active role and location filters (raw ranks or vanilla 0-4, switchable in the dialog).
LanguageData.WR_ResizeGripTip: Drag to resize the window (it can only grow from its content-fitted size). Double-click to return to automatic sizing.
LanguageData.WR_BlockerRoleTipWhat: A blocker role's jobs are never done: they are blocked ("will not do") even when a later role includes them.
LanguageData.WR_BlockerRoleTipWhy: Roles placed above the blocker still win, so you can allow exceptions by placing a role higher.
LanguageData.WR_ReasonFireFear: Genetically terrified of fire: blocks firefighting.
LanguageData.WR_RoleTipDisabledBoth: DISABLED globally and for this colonist
LanguageData.WR_RoleTipForcedOn: enabled, forced on for this colonist
LanguageData.WR_RoleTipForcedOnGlobalOff: FORCED ON for this colonist (role DISABLED globally)
LanguageData.WR_RoleCapAllJobs: any of the jobs in this role
LanguageData.WR_RoleCapSomeJobs: {0} of the {1} jobs in this role
LanguageData.WR_RoleTooYoung: {0} is too young for this role (minimum age {1}).
LanguageData.WR_RoleTooOld: {0} is too old for this role (maximum age {1}).
LanguageData.WR_MtcHatedWorkSignalDescription: More Than Capable permits this work, but it causes severe and escalating penalties.
LanguageData.WR_RoleAwfulSignal: {0} has an Awful signal for this role: {1}.
LanguageData.WR_ActChipClick: Cycle on, off, or forced on for this colonist
LanguageData.WR_ActChipDrag: Reorder or move to another colonist
LanguageData.WR_ColonistSearchTip: Searches colonist names. Separate terms with spaces; every term must match. Prefix a term with r: or role: to search assigned role names, or j: or job: to search jobs supplied by assigned roles. Example: br r:doc.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistRoleFilterTip: Lists colonists assigned the selected role. An assigned non-blocker role also matches when its jobs fully cover the selected role. This combines with the search, job, and location filters.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistJobFilterTip:
Selected: {0}
Lists colonists whose assigned non-blocker roles contain this job. This checks role coverage, not the colonist's current activity or vanilla work priority.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistScopeTip: Chooses which colony locations supply colonists to the table. Current location follows the active map; Everywhere includes settlements, caravans, and a traveling gravship.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistGroupTip: Divides the visible colonists into sections using the selected characteristic. Grouping does not change which colonists match the filters; section headers can be collapsed.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistSkillColumnsTip: Selects up to three skill columns for the table. Click a skill header to sort by it, or click its X to remove the column.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistRoleDisplayTip: Chooses how assigned role chips are drawn in the colonist table: full names, initials, or icons, with natural or equal-width grid spacing. This is a per-player display setting.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistClearFiltersTip: Clears the colonist-name search and the assigned-role and covered-job filters. The location scope, grouping, skill columns, and role display stay unchanged.
LanguageData.WR_ShipTip: The gravship, while it is not parked at a settlement (a settlement tile takes precedence).
LanguageData.WR_PasteRolesTip: Paste the copied roles onto this colonist.
LanguageData.WR_FixMyColonyTip: Replace every colonist's roles with their recommended roles.
LanguageData.WR_FixNeedsSingleLocation: Recommendations are computed per location. Narrow the scope filter to a single settlement or ship to use Fix My Colony.
LanguageData.WR_AutoManagedTip:
WorkRoles automatically updates role assignments for every colony at the top of each in-game hour.
Pinned assignments are preserved.
Disable "Auto-optimize colonies every in-game hour" on the Options tab to restore Fix My Colony.
LanguageData.WR_SetPriorityBlockedBody:
{0} attempted to set work priorities ({1}).
WorkRoles blocked {2} priority writes since the previous notice or the start of this game session.
WorkRoles owns priorities for role-managed colonists, so the change was ignored - the mod's other features are unaffected.
To get a similar effect with roles: on the Roles tab, create or edit a role containing that work and place it where you want it in each colonist's role list - or use a blocker role to forbid the work entirely.
This notice is shown once per mod per savegame.
LanguageData.WR_PreviewStale: The colony changed while the preview was open; nothing was applied.
LanguageData.WR_ReasonHunter: Carries a ranged weapon; hunting also trains Shooting.
LanguageData.WR_ReasonCoverage: Colony coverage: best available for this work.
LanguageData.WR_ReasonRemoved: Not in recommendation list. Pin roles you want to keep before applying.
LanguageData.WR_SignalAlreadyReflected: Already reflected in the displayed skill level
LanguageData.WR_PinnedTip: Pinned: Fix My Colony and Make It So never touch this assignment.
LanguageData.WR_WillBeRemoved: Not in recommendation list. Pin roles you want to keep before applying.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionAuto: Assigned automatically to every capable pawn.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionSignals: The configured signal threshold qualifies this pawn.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionCoverageDraft: Best remaining candidate selected to meet required coverage.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionTraining: Assigned through the training path for {0}.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionDirectSlot: Selected directly to fill slot {0} of {1} for {2}.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionTrainingSlot: Selected to fill slot {0} of {1} for {2}. A training waiver substituted {2} with {3} ({4}; {2} requires {5}).
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionTrainingSlotSimple: Selected to fill slot {0} of {1} for {2}. A training waiver substituted {2} with {3}.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionTrainingSlotUnknown: Selected to fill slot {0} of {1} through a training waiver, assigning {2}.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionDirectFallbackSlot: Selected directly to fill slot {0} of {1} for {2} because no training substitute qualified for that slot.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionCoverageRepairSlot: Selected directly to fill remaining required slot {0} of {1} for {2}.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionSignalSurplus: Selected as a surplus candidate based on signal verdict.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionAptitudeSurplus: Selected as a surplus candidate because the combined skill aptitude is at or above the level required for this role.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionHunter: Carries a ranged weapon and is capable of hunting.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionFire: Fire fear requires the firefighting blocker.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionNever: This role is configured to receive no recommendations.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionControlledByTraining: Controlled by {0}: assigned through its training path, not on its own.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionUnavailable: This role's work is unavailable until its research is finished.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionExcluded: This role is managed by rules and excluded from ordinary recommendations.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionIncapable: This pawn is incapable of this role's work.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionHunterRequirements: This pawn does not carry a ranged weapon.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionAwful: An Awful signal disqualifies this pawn.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionCoverageFilled: Required coverage was filled by higher-ranked candidates.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionWeakSignal: The signal verdict is below the configured threshold and required coverage did not select this pawn.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionNotSelected: This pawn was not selected by any recommendation rule.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionOutOfBand: This pawn's skill places it in a different band of the training path.
LanguageData.WR_RecDecisionOutqualified: Other, more qualified candidates were picked for the available slots.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreDefaultsTip: Recreate missing pre-made roles and training paths, return pre-made roles to their default groups, colors, and holder settings, and reset the recommendation order. A preview lets you pick what to restore.
LanguageData.WR_ExportTip: Write all role definitions (not assignments) to:\n{0}
LanguageData.WR_ImportClipboardInvalid: The clipboard does not contain a WorkRoles export.
LanguageData.WR_PaletteOverwriteInfo: Replaces all custom colors with the file's {0} palette entries.
LanguageData.WR_OverwriteReplaces: Applies all {0} roles from the file. Matching roles (same pre-made role, else same name) keep their colonist assignments.
LanguageData.WR_OverwriteDeletes: Deletes (not in file): {0} (colonists lose these assignments).
LanguageData.WR_PathsOverwriteInfo: Replaces all existing training paths with the file's {0} paths.
LanguageData.WR_RecOrderReplaceInfo: Replaces your recommendation order with the file's ({0} roles).
LanguageData.WR_ImportSummary: Import complete: {0} added, {1} updated, {2} deleted, {3} palette changes, {4} training paths.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreOverwriteWarning: ⚠ Highlighted items will overwrite changes you made.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreDuplicateHint: (a role with this name already exists)
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainRole: Creates the role from the mod's template.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainCoverage: Generates a role covering this work type.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainGroup: Moves the role back to group '{0}'.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainColor: Resets the color to the template default.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainJobs: Resets the role's job list to the mod's current default. Colonists keep their overall jobs: roles covering any removed jobs are assigned to them automatically.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainSnapColor: Replaces the generated color with the nearest palette color, so the color picker highlights it.
LanguageData.WR_RestoreExplainHolders: Resets the holder scale to the template default.
LanguageData.WR_NothingToRestore: Nothing to restore: all pre-made roles and training paths are present with their default groups, colors, and holder settings, the recommendation order is the default, and no jobs were moved.
LanguageData.WR_NameTaken: A role with this name already exists.
LanguageData.WR_DeleteConfirm: Delete role '{0}'? It will be removed from all colonists.
LanguageData.WR_UnusedJobsWarning: You have jobs that are not in any role.
LanguageData.WR_CoveredByTypeTip: Covered by the work type. Click to give this job its own (reorderable) entry.
LanguageData.WR_MissingDef: {0} is not present with the current mod list (inactive until its mod returns).
LanguageData.WR_DeadEntryTip: No effect: everything this entry covers is already covered by the entries above it. Move it up to prioritize it, or remove it.
LanguageData.WR_CompositeRoleTip: Composite roles bundle other roles: holders do the member roles' jobs in the member order. A composite role has no job list of its own.
LanguageData.WR_CompositeConfirm: Turn '{0}' into a composite role? Its selected jobs will be removed.
LanguageData.WR_CompositeRevertConfirm: Turn '{0}' back into a regular role? Its member roles will be removed.
LanguageData.WR_NoMembersHint: Add roles from the list on the left. Holders of this role do the member roles' jobs in the order shown here.
LanguageData.WR_NoCandidatesHint: No roles can be added. Members must be regular roles without hour or location rules, and a composite cannot contain another composite.
LanguageData.WR_MemberLockTip: Locked: this role is a member of a composite role. Remove it from every composite to change this setting.
LanguageData.WR_ScaleRenameTip: Rename this scale (roles referencing it follow).
LanguageData.WR_ScaleResetTip: Restore the values from before your edits (since selecting this role or scale).
LanguageData.WR_ScaleDeleteConfirm: Delete scale '{0}'?\n\n{1}. These roles will use Never instead.
LanguageData.WR_ScaleSaveAsTitle: Save changes as a new scale (this scale reverts to its saved values)
LanguageData.WR_ScaleDirectTip: Direct minimum for this band; the rest of the required total may be filled through training waivers. Raising it past the required total raises that total too. Click +1 (wraps at 8), right-click -1. Left-drag to copy across bands (right-click while dragging nudges the value, following the drag direction). Right-drag to ramp: one step per band, up dragging right, down dragging left.
LanguageData.WR_ScaleTrainingHelp: This role is a training role for {0} and assignments are therefore controlled by the tuning options for {0} (even when this is set to Never). However, you can still force minimum assignment counts for {1} here.
LanguageData.WR_ScaleTotalTip: Required total for this band, training waivers included. Raising it creates training-waiver slots; lowering it consumes them before lowering the direct minimum. Click +1, right-click -1. Left-drag to copy across bands (right-click while dragging nudges the value, following the drag direction). Right-drag to ramp: one step per band, up dragging right, down dragging left.
LanguageData.WR_VirtualRoleTip: Shown here because this role's jobs are covered by the parent role. It belongs to the "{0}" group.
LanguageData.WR_ConditionalRoleTip: Conditional roles turn themselves on and off based on rules: active hours and location. A role is conditional whenever any rule is set.
LanguageData.WR_AutoAssignTip: Newcomers (recruits, wanderers) automatically receive this role, and recommendations always place auto-assign roles first.
LanguageData.WR_CustomSwatchEmpty: Empty slot: click to pick a custom color. Custom colors are shared across all roles.
LanguageData.WR_CustomSwatchTip: Click to use this color. Right-click to redefine the slot.
LanguageData.WR_ClearRulesConfirm: Remove all rules from '{0}'? It becomes a manual role again.
LanguageData.WR_LocationNowhereTip: This role was restricted to locations that no longer exist. It remains disabled until you select another location.
LanguageData.WR_InvalidRoleTip: This role can never apply: it has no jobs, or every location it names no longer exists.
LanguageData.WR_GroupOverlayTip: Roles with rules display under Conditional Roles. The stored group returns when the rules are cleared.
LanguageData.WR_GroupCompositeTip: Composite roles display under Composite Roles.
LanguageData.WR_TreeToggleTip: Toggle nesting of covered roles under their combo role.
LanguageData.WR_PaletteModeTip: Arrange the role palette by relevant skill or by your role groups.
LanguageData.WR_SuppressedLocation: Off: not at this role's locations
LanguageData.WR_BillWorkerRoleTip: Only colonists actively holding this role work this bill; a conditional role applies its rules (e.g. active hours). Selecting a worker clears the role restriction and vice versa.
LanguageData.WR_NewWorkDetected: New work types detected. Roles created or extended: {0}
LanguageData.WR_SeedReportBody: Created {0} roles and assigned role sets to {1} colonist(s) based on their work priorities.
LanguageData.WR_SeedReportFailures: Some work could not be migrated:
